basic_details.short_information: In continuation of advertisement No. AS/JR.07/2026/Special Recruitment drive dated 19.10.2026, All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Ansari Nagar, New Delhi-110029 has announced that the walk-in interview and offline counseling for the post of Junior Resident for the remaining period of July Session 2026 will be held on 04.11.2026 at LT-04, AIIMS New Delhi. Candidates applying or who have applied for the walk-in interview are required to report at 09:00 AM (sharp), and candidates reporting after 10:00 AM will not be allowed.

important_instructions: Candidates applied or applying for the walk-in interview and counseling are requested to report at LT-04, AIIMS New Delhi at 09:00 AM (sharp). Candidates reporting after 10:00 AM will not be allowed under any circumstances. Candidates must bring all required original documents along with necessary self-attested photocopies for verification. The last date for submission of the application form is 31.10.2026 (Saturday) up to 01:00 PM.
